query:
WITH seen AS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM edges
                     WHERE source_id = $1 AND source_type = $2
                       AND target_id = $3 AND target_type = $4
                       AND valid_to IS NULL),
                 done AS (
                    UPDATE edges
                       SET valid_to = now()
                    WHERE source_id = $1 AND source_type = $2
                      AND target_id = $3 AND target_type = $4
                      AND valid_to IS NULL
                    RETURNING 1)
            SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM seen) AS "seen!", (SELECT count(*) FROM done) AS "done!"
